name: Event
description: An event on a calendar (forge 28e), the calendar.events contract's shape as fields: a one-off, a recurring series' master (with its rule), or an exception of a series (series and recurrenceId set). Views and tools read its occurrences (calOccurrence); edits go to events.

fields.name: Calendar
fields.description: The calendar it is on

fields.name: Title
fields.description: The event's title

fields.name: Start
fields.description: When it starts (for an all-day event, midnight UTC of its first day)

fields.name: End
fields.description: When it ends, exclusive (for an all-day event, midnight UTC after its last day)

fields.name: Time zone
fields.description: The IANA zone it is planned in; a recurring series repeats in it

fields.name: All day
fields.description: Whole days

fields.name: Rule
fields.description: A series' RFC 5545 RRULE, e.g. FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO; empty for a one-off

fields.name: Extra dates
fields.description: RDATE: extra starts of the series

fields.name: Excluded dates
fields.description: EXDATE: starts left out of the series (recurrence ids)

fields.name: Series
fields.description: For an exception: the series' master

fields.name: Recurrence id
fields.description: For an exception: the occurrence it replaces (its original start as an instant in UTC, or a date for all-day)

fields.name: Status
fields.description: confirmed, tentative or cancelled (a cancelled exception removes its occurrence)

fields.name: Shows as
fields.description: opaque (busy) or transparent (free)

fields.name: Location
fields.description: Where

fields.name: Video link
fields.description: The meeting's video link

fields.name: Organizer
fields.description: {email, name, user}

fields.name: Attendees
fields.description: [{email, name, user, response, optional}], response needsAction, accepted, tentative or declined

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Notes

fields.name: Outside id
fields.description: The event's id at the outside service

fields.name: Etag
fields.description: The outside version it was last read at

fields.name: iCalendar UID
fields.description: The UID invitations carry

fields.name: Hold
fields.description: The scheduling hold it belongs to (28h)

fields.name: Refused change
fields.description: An edit made here that the outside calendar refused because the event had changed there first: {set, at, reason}; the outside version was kept (28f)

access.read: principal.kind == 'app' || principal.owner || principal.hasRole('calWriter', record.calendar) || principal.hasRole('calReader', record.calendar)
